week_vs_nifty.flag_rule: 3 completed weeks of Top 10 average below Nifty 50
approaches: Grade equal-weight Top 10 vs Nifty 50 over the same Monday–Friday window (relative momentum, not raw P&L).
Three consecutive weeks of negative excess flags the book: pause new entries until one week of outperformance (hysteresis, not a one-week whipsaw).

Long book already uses index 200 DMA cash (Faber 2007 / trend-gated momentum). Do not also empty the short book on the first lost week — tight exits caused medium-term lag vs looser momentum (Capitalmind 2024–26).
Cross-sectional ML on daily returns is mostly noise vs 21-day rank (Brixloop NIFTY 200). Keep rank + regime; do not swap ST for a black-box predictor.
week_vs_nifty.action: ST book is not on a 3-week relative losing streak.

ranking_note: Long Suggested 10 is dual momentum: liquid, above 200 DMA, 6-month return > 0, then LT score. If Nifty is below its 200 DMA the *deployed* long book is cash (empty Suggested 10). Paper names for that Saturday still sit on Weekly — that tape is not the live book vs Nifty. Short Suggested 10 is a 5–10 day rank, not cash-gated, and has not predicted the next week on the Sep–Oct holdout. Scores are research rank, not a forecast, until the gated holdout in context.md passes.
